ety.text: Borrowed from Sanskrit दशकण्ठ (daśakaṇṭha). By surface analysis, दश (daś, “ten”) + कंठ (kaṇṭh, “neck; throat”).
Inherited from Old Hindi पीड (pīḍa), पीड़ा, from Prakrit पीडा f (pīḍā), from Sanskrit पीडा (pīḍā), from Proto-Indo-European *peysd- (“to crush”). Doublet of पीड़ा (pīṛā).

ety.text: Borrowed from Classical Persian بازیگر (bāzīgar). First attested as Old Hindi बाजीगर (bājīgara). By surface analysis, बाज़ी (bāzī) + -गर (-gar). Compare Assamese বাজিকৰ (bazikor), Bengali বাজিগর (bajigor), Gujarati બાજીગર (bājīgar), Kannada ಬಾಜಿಗಾರ (bājigāra), Odia ବାଜିଗର (bājigara), Punjabi ਬਾਜ਼ੀਗਰ (bāzīgar) / بازِی گَر (bāzī gar).
Inherited from Proto-New Indo-Aryan *बोर (bora) + Middle Indo-Aryan -𑀓- (-ka-). Compare Bengali বোরা (bōra), Gujarati બોરો (boro), Nepali बोरो (boro), Odia ବୋରା (borā), Punjabi ਬੋਰਾ /بورا (borā).
